items.title: AI Doesn't Reduce Work–It Intensifies It
items.title_zh: AI 没有减少工作，反而加剧了工作强度
items.summary: New research cited by Harvard Business Review finds that AI tools do not reduce work but intensify it, with employees working at a faster pace, taking on a broader scope and extending work into more hours. The article warns this can lead to workload creep, cognitive fatigue and burnout, and calls for company norms around AI use.

items.title: The effect of whitening on explanation performance
items.title_zh: 白化处理对解释性能的影响
items.summary: The paper studies whether data whitening, a common decorrelation preprocessing step, can reduce feature-attribution errors in explainable AI. Evaluating 16 attribution methods with 5 whitening transforms on the XAI-TRIS benchmark, it finds that some techniques improve explanation performance, but gains vary substantially across methods and model architectures.

items.title: Think Deep, Not Just Long: Measuring LLM Reasoning Effort via Deep-Thinking Tokens
items.title_zh: 深度思考，而非只是更长：用深度思考 token 衡量 LLM 推理投入
items.summary: The paper argues that raw token counts are unreliable proxies for reasoning quality and proposes measuring "deep-thinking tokens" whose internal predictions undergo significant revision in deeper layers before convergence. Across AIME 24/25, HMMT 25 and GPQA-diamond with GPT-OSS, DeepSeek-R1 and Qwen3, the deep-thinking ratio correlates positively with accuracy, and the authors introduce Think@n, a test-time scaling strategy that matches or exceeds self-consistency while reducing inference cost through early rejection of unpromising generations.

items.title: WIMLE: Uncertainty-Aware World Models with IMLE for Sample-Efficient Continuous Control
items.title_zh: WIMLE：面向样本高效连续控制的不确定性感知世界模型
items.summary: WIMLE extends Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation to model-based RL so that stochastic, multimodal world models can be learned without iterative sampling, with ensembles and latent sampling used to estimate predictive uncertainty and synthetic transitions weighted by confidence. Across 40 continuous-control tasks spanning DeepMind Control, MyoSuite and HumanoidBench, it reports better sample efficiency and competitive or stronger asymptotic performance than model-free and model-based baselines.

items.title: Atlas: Enabling Cross-Vendor Authentication for IoT
items.title_zh: Atlas：面向 IoT 的跨厂商认证
items.summary: Atlas is a framework that extends the web public-key infrastructure to IoT by issuing X.509 certificates through vendor-operated ACME clients and vendor-controlled DNS namespaces, enabling mutual TLS across administrative domains without hardware changes. Prototyped on ESP32 and Raspberry Pi, it provisions certificates in under 6 seconds per device and adds about 17 ms of latency.

items.title: When Less Is More? Diagnosing ASR Predictions in Sardinian via Layer-Wise Decoding
items.title_zh: 少即是多？通过逐层解码诊断撒丁语 ASR 预测
items.summary: Applying layer-wise decoding to a pretrained Wav2Vec2 model for Campidanese Sardinian, the authors find that truncating upper transformer layers improves phoneme error rates, with the best performance two layers before the final one.

items.title: Designing RNAs with Language Models
items.title_zh: 用语言模型设计 RNA
items.summary: The authors treat RNA design as conditional sequence generation, training an autoregressive language model with supervision and reinforcement learning to map target structures to sequences; across four datasets it beats state-of-the-art systems on metrics such as Boltzmann probability while running 1.7x faster.

items.title: Translating Dietary Standards into Healthy Meals with Minimal Substitutions
items.title_zh: 用最少替换把膳食标准转化为健康餐食
items.summary: Using What We Eat in America intake data for 135,491 meals, the authors identify 34 interpretable meal archetypes and condition a generative model and portion predictor on them to meet USDA nutritional targets. Generated meals follow recommended daily intake targets 47.0% better, and allowing one to three food substitutions yields meals that are 10% more nutritious and 19-32% cheaper on average.

items.title: Zero-Shot Instruction Following in RL via Structured LTL Representations
items.title_zh: 以结构化 LTL 表示实现强化学习中的零样本指令遵循
items.summary: The paper learns structured task representations for zero-shot instruction following in multi-task reinforcement learning by conditioning the policy on sequences of Boolean formulae built from a finite automaton of the task. A hierarchical neural architecture encodes the logical structure of the formulae, and an attention mechanism lets the policy reason about future subgoals, with experiments reporting strong generalization across complex environments.
